content: Happiness is when what you think, what you say, and what you do are in harmony.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
story:
A shy lawyer who faced humiliating racial segregation on South African trains, Gandhi transformed his personal outrage into Satyagraha (soul-force or truth-force). Leading millions of impoverished Indians against the British Empire without firing a single shot, he demonstrated that uncompromising nonviolence and personal self-discipline possess a moral power capable of bringing empires to their knees.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Mahatma Gandhi saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: What mental clutter or unrealistic expectation can you let go of to make room for simple joy?
